limitations: No complete ordinary ptr/lexical-owner migration, mailbox transport, runtime closure ABI or fraction implementation.
Source signature checks cover supported typed/variadic/generic and owner/access qualifiers; ordinary local lexical closure values are not supported.
Readonly regional transfer views do not implement general scalar assignment places.
No regional allocator/relative-pointer encoding, build configuration or toolchain changes.
